knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The guideline notes that microorganisms cannot be seen with the naked eye. Option B states that. The other options are not in the guideline.
The guideline lists the limits of sampling, including variable shedding and residual products, which make results hard to interpret. Cost and legality are not the reasons it gives.
The guideline keeps a role for sampling in specific cases, such as an outbreak or an unidentified cause of infection. Option B states that role; the others are not in the guideline.

practicalCriteria: Learner completes a checklist for one area and, if a residue or dryness problem is present, identifies it and re-cleans the surface.
Learner explains in their own words why a visual check does not confirm the absence of organisms.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Completed checklist signed by the assessor
Re-clean record for any failure found
stopWorkCriteria: The checklist cannot be completed because the schedule is missing for the area
A surface is visibly contaminated and the learner is asked to sign it off without re-cleaning
